1. The Company has provided performance guarantee amounting to USD 551,221 as determined on February 22, 2023 in favour of BK Asia Pac Pte. Ltd. ("BK Asia Pac") for securing the obligations of PT Sari Burger Indonesia as per the Master Franchisee and Development Agreement dated December 4, 2014 ("Indonesia MFDA"). The aforesaid guarantee amount would be determined, agreed and/or modified prior to every financial year end.
Pursuant to the Side Letter executed between the Company and PLK Apac Pte.Ltd ("PLK") on July 27, 2022, the Company has provided performance guarantee amounting to USD 12,53,656 as determined on July 27, 2022 in favour of PLK for securing the obligations of PT Sari Chicken Indonesia as per the Master Franchisee and Development Agreement dated July 27, 2022 executed between PT Sari Chicken Indonesia, PLK and PT Sari Burger Indonesia. The aforesaid guarantee amount would be determined, agreed and/or modified prior to every financial year end pursuant to the aforesaid Side Letter.
The Company has charged commission in respect of performance guarantee.

The Audit Committee through its approval dated July 29, 2024, had accorded its approval for granting of loans at applicable interest to PT Sari Burger Indonesia and/or PT Sari Chicken Indonesia for a total amount not exceeding INR 200 CR. The Board approved the granting of said loans at applicable interest rates subject to necessary approval of the shareholders pursuant to provisions of Section 185(2) of the Companies Act, 2013.
The shareholders at its Annual General Meeting held on September 19, 2024, approved the aforesaid transaction under Section 185(2).

The Borrowing, Investments, Loans and Finance Committe through its meeting dated June 19, 2024 approved the aforesaid investment.
